title: 第5章 师父柳海
content_zh:
第5章师父柳海
鹏海市，一栋高耸入云的摩天大厦内。
程子豪正躺在游戏椅上，戴着虚拟眼镜，忽然办公室敲门声音响起。
“进来。”程子豪的虚拟眼镜模式切换，改为现实模式，看向从门外走进来的一名中年男子。
中年男子进来后，先关上门，而后略显讨好道：“老板，滨海市星空格斗馆那边决定辞退许景明，我换了一个账号联系许景明，许景明又把我拉黑了。”
“还真是果断。”程子豪皮肤白皙，笑道，“黎渺渺将我拉黑，许景明也拉黑我们，他们俩还真有点意思。这就是所谓的情比金坚？哈哈哈……真有意思，对了，黎元平呢？他可是黎渺渺的大伯。”
“黎元平亲自去找黎渺渺的父母，可是，黎渺渺父母显然很认同许景明这个女婿，把黎元平给赶出来了。”中年男子说道。
“真够没用的。”
程子豪微微皱眉，“这个黎渺渺，还真是和其他歌手都不同，这么不在乎名利吗？”
“她都换直播平台了，最新一次直播，她就是在微世界直播的。”中年男子也无奈道，“而且她从来没跟我们平台签长约，一个月才直播一次，从来没在意过直播赚钱，非常佛系。老板，我们接下来怎么办？”
“黎渺渺和许景明，都是公众人物，态度又如此强硬。算了，这世间我喜欢的东西有很多，终究不可能全部得到。”程子豪摇头，“黎渺渺的事，暂时到此为止。但继续给我关注她……人是会变的，我就不信，她一直不在乎名利。”
“是。”中年男子点头笑道，“她可能还年轻，现在二十岁出头可能不在乎名利，可过几年，经过社会的毒打，认识到名利重要性，可能就变了。”
“几年后若是变得势利，我不一定瞧得上了。”程子豪淡然道，“下去吧。”
“是。”中年男子恭敬离去。
程子豪的虚拟眼镜又切换到沉浸模式，对他而言，黎渺渺仅仅是他生活的一个小水花，他根本没放在心上过。
沉浸模式内，巨大的股市画面显现，程子豪观看着，资本市场才是他真正在意的。
“虎鲨的股价，今天怎么跌了8%？也没发现有什么利空啊？”程子豪无法理解，虎鲨集团这种超大盘股，很少会有如此大跌幅。
“老爸命令过，为了分散风险，我的所有投资禁止碰虎鲨集团，让老爸烦去吧。”程子豪没再多想。
家族最大的资产就是8.2%的虎鲨集团股票，他当然关心。不过按家族规矩，他个人财产和虎鲨集团是没任何关联的。至于虎鲨集团股票大跌？父亲程立韦掌控集团三十余年，程子豪还是很相信父亲的能力的。
京城，一座中式别墅内，整个别墅除了一名管家机器人，仅有一名老人居住。

这名体型魁梧的老人正在餐桌旁，吃了几瓣大蒜，又大口啃着牛肉，煮熟的蔬菜也是吃了几口。
他正是世界武道圈的传奇人物——‘凶虎’柳海。
四十五岁参加第一届世界武道大赛，和来自世界各地的高手比拼。要知道只有世界排名前32位的才有资格参加！参加的大多是三十岁左右，柳海绝对算是高龄选手了。
他连续五届杀进去，全部都是前三，第五届更是获得世界第一！担当夏国国家队主教练足足二十年！
论传奇性，夏国近三十年来，仅有两位武道高手能媲美他。论资历，他是最老的，夏国顶尖职业武道选手，大多都得称他一声师父！
今年七十多岁了，柳海每年依旧有半年时间闭关独居，进行苦修。
像吃饭，他每天吃五顿，以牛肉为主，蔬菜等配菜为辅。没办法，以他的训练强度，吃少了扛不住。
“嗯？”柳海有着一双虎眸，散发着霸气。霸气说来玄乎，那是强大体格带来的强大生物磁场。身高一米九二，体重一百一十公斤的柳海，在世界武道大赛规矩最不完善的前五届都能杀进前三，并且从未受伤，可见身体、技艺都达到惊人地步。
“这什么玩意？”柳海看着面前光幕显现的资料，瞪大眼，“这龟儿子，欺负到我徒弟头上了？”
“方星龙。”柳海喊道。
光幕中显现出方星龙的影像，方星龙恭敬连道：“师父，我昨天想了一夜，实在想不到别的法子，所以才把这些告诉师父。师弟他高中就进省队，这么多年和苦行僧一样，一门心思在武道上。谁想程子豪还要来欺负他。师弟在我面前不肯多说，我打听了，似乎和师弟的女友有关。”
“情情爱爱的事，真是烦人。多少年轻人，因为情情爱爱毁掉前途。”柳海摇头，像他七十多岁，每年依旧闭关半年，谁都不见。
情爱世俗，只会影响他出招的速度！
“师弟的事，师父，你有法子吗？”方星龙问道，他知道自家师父关系网非常大。
“人家一个商业大集团，我能有啥办法，我先想想，这事你就别多管了。”柳海说道。
“是，师父，我听你的。”方星龙连应道。
光幕关闭。
柳海坐在那，一边思索一边啃着熟牛肉，只觉得嘴里的牛肉也没滋味了。
“景明这小子还是体格太弱，如果多练三年体格，再杀进世界武道大赛……就不会断了腿，毁掉了前途。”柳海暗叹，“他枪法天赋太高，世界排名提升太快，过早地杀进世界武道大赛，反而害了他。”
二十岁就登上最高级别的世界武道大赛，还是太年轻了。

“以他的天赋，若是二十三四岁，再杀进世界武道大赛，都有望拿世界第一。拿个世界第一，风风光光，哪会被逼成这样。”柳海思索着，他也只是个武夫，想帮徒弟也不容易。
“老郭。”柳海开口喊道。
面前光幕凝聚，光幕中一道人影出现，是坐在办公桌前的一名花白头发的老者。
“海哥，有事？”花白头发老者也是位高权重，但面对年龄比他小三岁的柳海，依旧很敬重，还称呼一声‘海哥’，双方是几十年的交情了。
“老郭，那个国家重点栽培名单。”柳海放下手中的牛肉，“我不是有一个推荐名额吗？我想了想，我准备推荐许景明。”
“许景明？”花白头发老者想了下，道，“你有推荐资格，但最终还是要经过审核。这次名单一共也就二十人！你们这些武道大师，就占了十二位。其它格斗流派也占了五位。只剩下最后三个名额，许景明想要竞争这三个名额……实话实说，他资历低了些。”
“景明，今年才二十九岁，潜力很大。而且他腿伤严重都能杀到世界武道大赛八强，如果没腿伤完全能冲世界第一。”柳海说道。
“你说的这些我们都知道，但我必须告诉你，他竞争三个名额的希望比较低，你确定要推荐他？”花白头发老者问道。
“我这些年最看好的几个徒弟，大多都拿过世界前三，获得了武道大师称号。唯有景明和小童有些可惜，小童如今早就放弃武道了，景明这些年可从来没放弃过，多年如一日，就这心性，也更值得栽培。”
“这样，海哥，你赶紧写一封详细的推荐信，越快越好，最好今天就发给我，我好发给上面的评选委员们。”花白头发老者道，“至于成功与否，还是要经过上面最终评审。”
“好。”柳海点头。
待得光幕消散，柳海又继续啃着牛肉，思索着：“历届世界武道大赛，夏国拿过世界前三的一共有十二位！这十二位，年龄最大的是我，还有一位残疾的，好几位身材走形的，连得癌症的都有一个。可这十二位全部列入栽培名单，残疾、癌症、年老，都可以栽培？”
“上面说，是天大的好事，详细情况却不透露。”
“也不知道是什么天大的好事。”柳海想道，“如果景明也能成为名单中的一员，也算是一份机遇了。”
柳海的观念很朴素，徒弟遇到麻烦了？
徒弟自身强大了，麻烦也就没了，甚至变成对方的麻烦！

Chapter 5 Master Liu Hai
In Penghai City, inside a skyscraper towering into the clouds.
Cheng Zihao was lying on the gaming chair, wearing virtual glasses, when suddenly there was a knock on the door at the office.
"Come in." Cheng Zihao switched the mode of his virtual glasses to the real mode and looked at a middle-aged man who walked in from the door.
After the middle-aged man came in, he closed the door first, and then said in a slightly flattering manner: "Boss, the Binhai Star Fighting Gym decided to fire Xu Jingming. I changed my account to contact Xu Jingming, and Xu Jingming blocked me again."
"Really decisive." Cheng Zihao, with fair skin, said with a smile, "Li Miaomiao blocked me, and Xu Jingming also blocked us. They are both really interesting. Is this the so-called love is stronger than gold? Hahaha... It's really interesting. By the way, where is Li Yuanping? He is Li Miaomiao's uncle."
"Li Yuanping went to find Li Miaomiao's parents in person, but Li Miaomiao's parents obviously recognized Xu Jingming as his son-in-law and kicked Li Yuanping out," the middle-aged man said.
"It's so useless."
Cheng Zihao frowned slightly, "This Li Miaomiao is really different from other singers. Does he not care about fame and fortune?"
"She has changed live broadcast platforms. The latest live broadcast she did was live broadcast in Micro World." The middle-aged man said helplessly, "And she has never signed a long-term contract with our platform. She only broadcasts once a month. She has never cared about making money through live broadcasts. She is very Buddhist. Boss, what should we do next?"
"Li Miaomiao and Xu Jingming are both public figures, and their attitudes are so tough. Forget it, there are many things I like in this world, and after all, I can't get them all." Cheng Zihao shook his head, "Li Miaomiao's matter is over for now. But continue to pay attention to her... I don't believe that people will change. She has never cared about fame and fortune."
"Yes." The middle-aged man nodded and smiled, "She may still be young. She may not care about fame and fortune now that she is in her early twenties. But in a few years, after being severely beaten by society and realizing the importance of fame and fortune, she may change."
"If you become snobbish in a few years, I may not necessarily like you." Cheng Zihao said calmly, "Go on."
"Yes." The middle-aged man left respectfully.
Cheng Zihao's virtual glasses switched to immersion mode again. To him, Li Miaomiao was just a small splash in his life, and he didn't take it to heart at all.
In the immersion mode, a huge stock market screen appeared. Cheng Zihao watched, and the capital market was what he really cared about.
"Why did Tiger Shark's stock price fall by 8% today? Didn't you find any negative news?" Cheng Zihao couldn't understand that very large-cap stocks like Tiger Shark Group rarely experienced such a big drop.
"Dad has ordered that in order to spread risks, all my investments are prohibited from contacting the Tiger Shark Group. Let dad worry about it." Cheng Zihao didn't think much more.
The family's largest asset is 8.2% of Tiger Shark Group shares, so of course he cares about it. However, according to family rules, his personal property has nothing to do with the Tiger Shark Group. As for the sharp drop in Tiger Shark Group’s stock? His father, Cheng Liwei, has been in charge of the group for more than 30 years, and Cheng Zihao still believes in his father's abilities.
In Beijing, in a Chinese-style villa, apart from a housekeeper robot, there is only one old man living in the entire villa.
The burly old man was sitting at the dining table, eating a few cloves of garlic, chewing on beef, and taking a few bites of cooked vegetables.
He is none other than the legendary figure in the world’s martial arts circle—‘Fierce Tiger’ Liu Hai.
At the age of forty-five, he participated in the first World Martial Arts Competition and competed with masters from all over the world. You must know that only the top 32 in the world are eligible to participate! Most of the participants are around thirty years old, and Liu Hai is definitely considered an older player.
He made it to five consecutive tournaments, ranking in the top three in all of them, and even ranked first in the world in the fifth tournament! He has been the head coach of Xia Guo’s national team for twenty years!
In terms of legendary status, in the past thirty years in the Xia Kingdom, there were only two martial arts masters who could rival him. On capitalLi, he is the oldest, most of the top professional martial arts players in Xia Kingdom have to call him master!
Now over 70 years old, Liu Hai still spends half a year every year in seclusion and self-cultivation.
For example, he eats five meals a day, mainly beef, supplemented by vegetables and other side dishes. There was no way, with the intensity of his training, he couldn't bear it if he ate too little.
"Huh?" Liu Hai has a pair of tiger eyes, exuding domineering. Domineering is mysterious, it is a powerful biological magnetic field brought by a strong physique. Liu Hai, who is 1.92 meters tall and weighs 110 kilograms, has been able to reach the top three in the first five World Martial Arts Competitions with the most imperfect rules, and has never been injured. This shows that his body and skills have reached an astonishing level.
"What the hell is this?" Liu Hai looked at the information displayed on the light screen in front of him, his eyes widened, "Has this son of a bitch bullied my disciple?"
"Fang Xinglong." Liu Hai shouted.
Fang Xinglong's image appeared in the light screen, and Fang Xinglong said respectfully: "Master, I thought about it all night yesterday, and I really can't think of any other way, so I told Master this. Junior brother, he joined the provincial team in high school, and has been like an ascetic for so many years, focusing on martial arts. Who would have thought that Cheng Zihao would come to bully him. Junior brother refused to say more in front of me, but I asked around, and it seems to be related to junior brother's girlfriend."
"Love and love are really annoying. How many young people have ruined their futures because of love and love." Liu Hai shook his head, as if he was in his seventies and still stayed in seclusion for half a year every year without seeing anyone.
Love in the secular world will only affect the speed of his moves!
"Junior brother's matter, master, do you have any ideas?" Fang Xinglong asked. He knew that his master's network was very large.
"They're a big business group. What can I do? I'll think about it first, so you don't have to worry about it." Liu Hai said.
"Yes, Master, I listen to you." Fang Xinglong responded.
The light curtain closes.
Liu Hai sat there, chewing on the cooked beef while thinking, and felt that the beef in his mouth had no taste.
"Jing Ming is still too weak. If he had trained his body for three more years before entering the World Martial Arts Competition... he would not have broken his leg and ruined his future." Liu Hai sighed secretly, "His marksmanship talent is too high and his world ranking rose too fast. Entering the World Martial Arts Competition too early has actually harmed him."
It is still too young to enter the highest level of world martial arts competition at the age of twenty.
"With his talent, if he entered the World Martial Arts Competition at the age of twenty-three or four, he would be expected to be number one in the world. How could he be forced to be like this if he is number one in the world and is so glorious?" Liu Hai thought, he was just a martial artist, and it was not easy to help his apprentice.
"Lao Guo." Liu Hai shouted.
The light curtain in front of him condensed, and a figure appeared in the light curtain. It was an old man with gray hair sitting at the desk.
"Brother Hai, what's the matter?" The gray-haired old man also held a high position, but he still respected Liu Hai, who was three years younger than him, and even called him "Brother Hai". The two parties had been friends for decades.
"Lao Guo, that's the national key cultivation list." Liu Hai put down the beef in his hand, "Don't I have a recommendation quota? I thought about it and I'm going to recommend Xu Jingming."
"Xu Jingming?" The gray-haired old man thought for a moment and said, "You have the qualifications to recommend, but you still have to go through the review in the end. There are only twenty people in the list this time! You martial arts masters account for twelve. Other fighting schools also account for five. There are only the last three places left, and Xu Jingming wants to compete for these three places... To be honest, he is a little underqualified."
"Jing Ming is only twenty-nine years old this year and has great potential. Moreover, if he has a serious leg injury, he can reach the quarterfinals of the World Martial Arts Competition. If he had not had the leg injury, he would have reached the top of the world." Liu Hai said.
"We all know what you said, but I must tell you that his hope of competing for the three spots is relatively low. Are you sure you want to recommend him?" the gray-haired old man asked.
"I have watched the most in recent yearsMost of the good disciples have ranked among the top three in the world and have won the title of martial arts master. Only Jing Ming and Xiao Tong feel a little regretful. Xiao Tong has given up martial arts a long time ago, but Jing Ming has never given up in these years. It has been the same for many years, and his character is worth cultivating. "
"Well, Brother Hai, hurry up and write a detailed recommendation letter. The sooner the better. It's best to send it to me today so that I can send it to the selection committee members above. "The gray-haired old man said, "As for success or failure, it still has to go through the final review above. "
"good. "Liu Hai nodded.
After the light curtain dissipated, Liu Hai continued to chew the beef and thought: "In all the previous world martial arts competitions, Xia Guo has won a total of twelve top three in the world! Among these twelve, the oldest one is me, there is another disabled person, several are out of shape, and one even has cancer. But these twelve people are all listed on the cultivation list, and those with disabilities, cancer, and old age can all be cultivated? "
“It was said above that it was a great thing, but the details were not disclosed. "
“I don’t know what a great thing it is. Liu Hai thought, "If Jing Ming can also become a member of the list, it will be an opportunity." "
Liu Hai's concept is very simple. Is his apprentice in trouble?
When the apprentice becomes stronger, his troubles will disappear, and he may even become the other party's trouble!
